Definition: from G842; self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence:--contentment, sufficiency.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says godliness with contentment is great gain, and that God is able to make all grace abound so that believers, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work. The word means contentment, or a competence that needs nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that contentment is not having everything, it is needing nothing more than what God has already given.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
